title: Confined Space Entry Permit
name: Confined Space Entry Permit
description: Permit for controlled entry into confined spaces with atmosphere, isolation, communication and rescue controls.

fields.label: RAMS / Safe System of Work Reference

sections.title: CONFINED SPACE HAZARDS AND ISOLATION
items: Entry is necessary and the work cannot reasonably be completed without entering the space
Hazards arising from the space, process and proposed work have been assessed
Mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic equipment has been isolated where required
Pipelines and process connections have been isolated, blanked or otherwise secured where required
Potential for flooding, engulfment or material ingress has been controlled
Heat, residues, biological hazards and hazardous substances have been considered
Safe access and egress have been established and will remain available

sections.title: ATMOSPHERIC TESTING AND VENTILATION
items: Atmosphere has been tested before entry at representative levels and locations
Oxygen concentration is within the safe range specified by the risk assessment
Flammable gases or vapours are below the specified entry limit
Toxic contaminants are below the applicable exposure / entry limits
Gas detector has a current calibration / function check and is suitable for expected contaminants
Ventilation is sufficient and positioned so that it does not introduce contaminants
Continuous or periodic monitoring arrangements are defined for the duration of entry

fields.label: Calibration / Bump Test Reference or Date

sections.title: ENTRY CONTROLS, PPE AND COMMUNICATION
items: All entrants are trained, competent and medically fit where required
The attendant will remain at the entry point and will not undertake conflicting duties
Reliable communication between entrants and the attendant has been tested
Entry / exit arrangements suit the number of entrants and potential casualty recovery
Required PPE and respiratory protective equipment have been checked before entry
Lighting and electrical equipment are suitable for the environment
Entry and exit of each person will be recorded and everyone accounted for

sections.title: EMERGENCY AND RESCUE ARRANGEMENTS
items: A site-specific rescue plan has been prepared before entry
Rescue arrangements do not rely solely on the emergency services
Rescue personnel are available, trained and briefed
Required rescue equipment is immediately available and has been checked
Casualty retrieval has been considered for the actual access route and space geometry
Alarm and emergency communication methods have been tested
First-aid and resuscitation arrangements are available where required

sections.title: EXIT, HAND-BACK AND CLOSE-OUT
items: All entrants have exited and are accounted for
Tools, materials and temporary equipment have been removed or safely handed over
The space has been secured against unauthorised re-entry
Isolations will only be removed under the appropriate isolation / reinstatement procedure
Any defects, contamination or changed conditions have been recorded and communicated
